title: Momoi Airi — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for making time to meet, Airi. I know you have your stream tonight.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I should be thanking you. I'm glad I get to see my friends on my birthday!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alrighty, everybody pick up a glass!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To Airi, the birthday girl!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Shizuku, Ena & Mizuki
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, Airi, here!
Your present from me and Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A gift from the two of you... I wonder what it is. Can I open this bag?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! We wanna hear what you think!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's...! It's so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What is this pouch?! It's got a cat embroidered onto it! And exactly the kind I like!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right? I came up with the cat's design.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, I did my very best embroidering it, with some guidance from Shizuku♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks so much, Shizuku! You helped me make the cat just like Ena's design.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena, Mizuki... Shizuku, too. Thank you all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This must have taken a while, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You could say that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But that's how much we wanted to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you so much. I'll treasure this pouch.
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm done looking over the script.
To finish off, I think I'll do one last check of the equipment.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi is very focused.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She has been excited for her stream all this time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I think now is the time for what we have to show her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi! Come over here a minute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How about a little break? There's something we want you to see.
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Something you want me to see?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Could you take a look at our office space?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh...? That's a pretty big cardboard box.
What's inside?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's full of birthday presents addressed to you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?! Everything in here?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Remember how Saito got a PO box set up for us so we can receive mail? Apparently some fans sent gifts to it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By the way, this is just the first box. Saito went to get the rest!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All this, for me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I think everyone wants to celebrate the Airi they love so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The stream's about to start... But I'm so happy, I might cry.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've received all these birthday blessings, so I've gotta thank everyone in the best way possible!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm gonna rock this stream!
Help me out, girls!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, Akito & Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're in the US right now, so we recorded a birthday song for you with some people we met at the Academy of Music here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It came out to be quite an energetic performance, so I believe you'll enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We stuffed in enough birthday well-wishes to match everyone there in Japan, so we really want you to see it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Momoi. Thanks for everything at the Shibu Schools Fest.
Um... It'd be nice to work with you again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Doesn't that sound a tad stiff, Nene?
It's a friend's birthday, you could stand to show more energy and—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Dun da-da-DUN-DUN-DUN♪
Happy birthday, Airi☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Here goes the celebratory cannon! Three, two, one...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Gwaaah! You two have far too much energy!
Balance! Can there be no balance?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Anyway...! We hope you have a great birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Momoi.
It'd be great to have another tea party when we get the chance.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think Momoi likes Japanese sweets, so it could be good to serve some green tea like you would for tea ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? W-Would I manage...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think you'd be fine if you asked Airi to teach you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A tea party between us and Airi... I like it! Let's find a time and give it a shot!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
We'll be counting on you when that happens, Airi!
I really hope you're having the best birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Momoi.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Happy birthday♪
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I had so much fun celebrating with everyone!
I mean, you were super happy about it, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It was worth discussing how we should celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, it's funny how all that thinking just brought us to eating lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, that seemed like the best idea to let us talk a bunch and tell Airi happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Airi, I know work is gonna keep you busy, but I hope you'll make this a great year♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One more time, Airi, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I got to see you beaming every time someone wished you a happy birthday, and that made it a happy day for me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I felt the same when we saw all the comments from everyone who came to see your stream. They weren't for me, but they still made me feel so warm inside.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Just look at me, I got moved to tears there at the end of the stream!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It was a surprise to see Airi start crying too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure when she saw Minori's tears, she just couldn't hold back any longer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I love that side of you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, me too.
Airi, we're all wishing you a very happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for celebrating with me so much today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The way I see it, having people outside your family celebrate your birthday is a very fortunate thing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, birthdays are all about saying, “Thanks for coming into this world” or “Thanks for being here”, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: People who aren't even family feel that way about you, and show it in all kinds of different ways.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why it made me so happy every time someone wished me a happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll use this year to return the favor for all your well-wishes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As Airi Momoi the idol, of course!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Lovely! Fairy! Airi... Momoi!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll see you later!
